newsitem.title: EGYPT: Telemisr year end profits up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Telemisr year end profits up 10 pct.

text.p: Telemisr/Arab Radio Transistor and Electronics Supplies said on Monday it made net after-tax profits of 12 million pounds ($3.53 million) in the financial year 1995/6, 10 percent up on 10.906 million in the previous year. The years end June 30.
The company is proposing to distribute 8.333 million pounds, equivalent to 4.17 pounds for each of the two million shares, against 7.250 million in the previous year.
The state sold 76.26 percent of the shares in September at 30.00 pounds a share and the shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Sunday at 31.70 pounds.
Net sales in the year were worth 183.221 million pounds, 7.8 percent up on 170.037 million in the previous year.
At the end of the year, shareholders' funds were worth 32.211 million pounds, against 28.019 million one year earlier.
